sloka: एवं महेश्वरेणैव कृतनामा स रावणः ।अभिवाद्य महादेवमारुरोहाथ पुष्पकम् ।। ७.१६.४७ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ maheśvareṇaiva kṛtanāmā sa rāvaṇaḥ ।abhivādya mahādevamārurohātha puṣpakam ।। 7.16.47 ॥

translations.english: Thus, Ravana, whose name was indeed established by Maheśvara, then saluted Mahadeva and ascended the Pushpaka chariot.
